parsed.answer: Yes. NW1004 is currently "In transit" and is going to Coimbra, PT, so a change to your office in Coimbra is possible free of charge. Address changes are free until the parcel reaches "Out for delivery". Once it is out for delivery, the address can no longer be changed, and you could only refuse the parcel. Please send me the full office address, including the street, number, postcode and any floor or unit, so the change can be made before the parcel is out for delivery. The promised delivery date is 15 November 2026.
